verdict.rationale: The project's GitHub docs say the agent itself clones, branches, creates worktrees, commits, pushes, and opens and reviews pull requests via `gh`, which covers the PR-production half of the story. Nothing documents starting from a tracked issue, such as reading or linking a GitHub issue or tracker ticket, or running the issue-to-PR flow end-to-end. missing for 10: documented issue ingestion or linking as the starting point, an end-to-end issue-to-PR workflow description, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end

citations.quote: The agent clones, branches, creates worktrees, commits, pushes, and opens and reviews pull requests with `gh`.
omnirush.ai is a desktop app for working with a coding agent on your own projects.
